#: The local server: what the launch says about a port, and what a request is refused with.
#keys: A key is a latin label, never a sentence. Substitution is by name: %(name)s.
#adding: A new section goes into a NEW FILE in this folder - no existing file is rewritten.
serve.foreignServer: the server at %(url)s was started outside MO2 and cannot see the build's meshes; close it and start again from inside MO2
serve.indexNotANumber: index must be a whole number, not %(value)r
serve.leavingWithParent: process %(pid)d, which started the server, has ended - leaving with it
serve.meshNotOpen: no mesh open: name one with the name= or index= key
serve.notMorphbench: whatever answers at %(url)s, it is not morphbench
serve.openMeshOnPage: the server is already up at %(url)s: pick a mesh on the page, --nif does not apply here
serve.parentGone: the process that started the server (%(pid)d) is already gone
serve.portSilent: something is at %(url)s but did not answer within %(seconds).0f s: if that is our server walking a large folder, try again later
serve.portTaken: port %(port)d is taken by another program; name a different one with --port
serve.rootNotGiven: no browse root: name a folder with the root= key
